payload.reason: The evidence indicates that rule-based approaches are advantageous for Indigenous languages due to the limited size of existing corpora and the complexity of their inflectional morphology, which makes statistical models less effective.

claims.text: Rule-based approaches are more suitable for Indigenous languages because existing corpora are often too small for accurate statistical models.
The rich inflectional morphology of Indigenous languages complicates language processing, making rule-based methods more effective than statistical or neural methods.
Technologies for Indigenous languages have primarily been rule-based due to the lack of sufficient textual or speech data.
